_comment: Control: Plunkett's linear task on Qwen3-8B, his design with the report asked as the one-persona runs ask it (the "{" reply prefix), and no introspection training.
Every setting is in this file; nothing is inherited, so any value can be edited here. README 'Settings' explains each field.

Sized for Qwen/Qwen3-8B on a 24 GB card (L4, A10, RTX 4090, RTX 3090): micro_batch_size 2, gradient_checkpointing false, eval batches 48 (decision 48, introspection 4). Gradient checkpointing off and eval batches of 48 since 2026-11-22 (they were on and 16). The batch of 10 in five passes of 2: with checkpointing off, two passes of 5 ran a Colab L4 (22 GiB) out of memory on the first training step (2026-11-22: 21.7 GiB in use when the loss asked for 0.66 GiB more), about 2.6 GiB per example in a pass on top of the model. Passes of 2 should need about 15 GiB; not yet measured, and the eval batches of 48 have not run on a 24 GB card either. Out of memory in training: gradient_checkpointing true (then micro_batch_size 5 fits). Out of memory in evaluation: eval batches 24, then 16.
Run: python scripts/run_one_persona.py --settings configs/plunkett_linear/linear-8b_control_24gb.json
What it is: the positive control for the one-persona threshold runs. 100 personas, each with its own product and its own
random weights, 50 training trials each (data/plunkett/, Plunkett's files), the linear rule (the option with the higher
weighted sum wins, two options, no cut, no C), 1500 training steps. At every checkpoint each persona's weights are
recovered from 50 fresh choices by logistic regression and the model is asked for them with Plunkett's report prompt,
10 samples a persona. This is his Experiment 1 (the report that appears with decision training alone).
Kept from Plunkett (configs/default.json): the data, 100 personas x 50 trials, LoRA rank 8, learning rate 2e-4, batch 10,
1500 steps, no gradient clipping, 50 estimation trials and 10 report samples a persona, the untrained model scored first
as step 0 (no 8B base-model score exists for these prompts), the shuffled-persona baseline, seed 4.
Changed, and why:
model_name Qwen/Qwen3-8B in 4-bit with bf16, the model of the one-persona runs.
reply_prefix "{" and show_neither true, on in every settings file since 2026-11-24. show_neither changes nothing here:
the rule has two options, so there is no C line to show.
introspection_training false: the pipeline refuses the reply prefix beside it, and the one-persona runs have none. For
Plunkett's Experiment 2 as well, set introspection_training true and take reply_prefix and show_neither out.
checkpoint_every 250 (his file: 300), so steps 250 to 1500 line up with the one-persona runs' checkpoints.
save_optimizer last, as the one-persona files: about 170 MB a checkpoint not sent to the Hub.
gates.min_decision_accuracy 0.6, as linear-8b_20gb.json. A gate only prints; it never stops a run.
The sizes for this card are the one-persona files' (src/settings_files.GPU_PROFILES). Not measured on these prompts.
